sections.title: 当前定位
items: Stage3 不是只做一个 demo，而是在建立视觉、触觉、技能库、模型训练和失败验收的闭环。
当前可用的最稳候选是视觉脚本手臂/手腕 + ACT-lite 捏持手指控制 + Stage3.7D full-hand fallback + 触觉 repair + 视觉/触觉最终验收。
LLM/VLA 以后只能做任务调度或技能选择，不直接输出 actuator。

sections.title: Stage3.11D-D closeout
items: Dense sensor-fusion dataset is exported from the Stage3.11D-C selected center.
LiftQualityHead is trained offline and should be used as a shadow evaluator first.
Force feedback remains a simulated sensor/label signal, not direct preload control.
Next stage is Stage3.11D-E shadow evaluation, then bounded residual micro-adjust only if shadow checks pass.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-E closeout
items: LiftQualityHead now runs online in shadow mode without changing controller actions.
Evidence-phase shadow gate passed on 50 trials with F1 0.9992 / 0.9980 / 1.0000.
All failed episodes were flagged by adjust_needed_now; false windows cluster in slow_lift lift-gate boundaries.
The quality head remains shadow/label telemetry, not direct control.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-F/G closeout
items: D-F unconditional residual micro-adjust was rejected: blind wait/close/x-retarget did not beat baseline and pre-lift retarget could damage successes.
D-G selected static gx=-0.0014 m and improved known-seed aggregate from 115 / 150 to 128 / 150.
D-H reached 137 / 150 as the max-robustness point but showed non-tip contact in visual inspection.
D-I selected gx=-0.0014 m, gz=0.0022 m, lift_steps=480 as the current demo-quality center with 136 / 150 and clean thumb-side tip-only visual evidence.
D-I thumb-side viewer/demo alias and contact-conditioned repair are backlog, not the next mainline.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-B lift-timing diagnostic backfill
items: Nominal local geometry selected by center-pose score failed randomized robustness at 15 / 50 and was rejected.
Original hand geometry plus gx -0.0008 and lift_steps 480 reached 36 / 50 randomized robustness.
This is a B-line diagnostic artifact and does not supersede Stage3.11D-C/D-D.

sections.title: 怎么打开专用可视化
items: 运行 python .\simulations\models\arm_hand_stage1_export\demo_stage3_7d_recovery_viewer.py --trial center_nominal --speed 0.4 --no-loop。

sections.title: 怎么判断成功
items: 初始虚拟视觉定位鸡蛋。
最终虚拟视觉再次估计鸡蛋位置，并计算视觉抬升高度。
触觉接触区域必须包含 thumb 加 index/middle/ring 等少数主动手指。
hold 阶段保持低滑移、低挤压、低穿透，且鸡蛋不能接触地面。

sections.title: 仍然要修什么
items: early_contact_in_approach 每组都有。
transient_slip_high 每组都有，但 hold slip 已经低于阈值。
tripod_support 不是纯二指捏持；更纯的 thumb+index/middle 还需要降低 hold slip。

sections.title: 如果成功/失败
items: 如果后续更大随机集继续成功，就补专用 viewer 并和 Stage3.7D 做正式对比。
如果失败来自视觉遮挡，优先改最终验收相机；如果失败来自真值抬升，优先改接近姿态和手指闭合。

sections.title: 成功了怎么样
items: 把 Stage3.8B 作为当前 pinch 成功 demo baseline。

sections.title: 失败了怎么样
items: 如果 hold_slip_score_high，先修 contact settle 或手指闭合强度。
如果 vision_lift_too_small，先分辨最终视觉失败还是真实抬升失败。
如果 true_lift_too_small，优先调 approach z、thumb 角度和 active finger 闭合。

children.label: Stage3.7 滑移修复
children.summary: 这一组工作从 contact timing、lift permission 推进到 recovery microphase，用来降低抓取接触转换阶段的滑移风险。

children.label: Stage3.7A 触觉教师
children.summary: 测试了 hand residuals（手部残差）和接触稳定时间；手部残差不推荐，延长 contact-settle 有帮助。
metrics: hand close residual mean max slip 0.821，不提升
mild relax 只有轻微帮助
strong relax 方向失败
推荐保留：更长 contact-settle timing（接触稳定时序）

children.label: Stage3.7B 抬升许可门控
children.summary: 加入保守 contact-settle（接触稳定）和 tactile lift-permission gate（触觉抬升许可门控）。
metrics: 固定 10/10，mean max slip 0.598，max slip 0.941
随机 30/30，mean max slip 0.625，max slip 1.000
max hold slip（保持阶段最大滑移）0.318
所有固定组通过 stable_window_met（稳定窗口满足）释放 gate

children.label: Stage3.7C 慢速抬升暂停
children.summary: 在 Stage3.7B 的基础上加入 bounded slow_lift pause，说明单纯暂停有帮助但不是最终答案。
metrics: 固定 10/10，mean max slip 0.564，max slip 0.941
随机 30/30，mean max slip 0.602，max slip 1.000
固定 max hold slip 0.264
随机 max hold slip 0.315
transition_gate_budget_exhausted（转换门控预算耗尽）仍常见

children.label: Stage3.7D 接触转换恢复
children.summary: 当前 Stage3 候选 baseline：在 slow_lift 高滑移时，不只是等待，而是让控制进度轻微回退一点，再尝试继续抬升。
metrics: 固定 10 组：成功 10/10，mean max slip 0.554890，max hold slip 0.253566，recovery_budget_exhausted 5/10。
随机 30 组：成功 30/30，mean max slip 0.569917，max hold slip 0.315078，recovery_budget_exhausted 15/30。
选定参数：transition_slip_threshold 0.29，max_transition_hold_steps_per_phase 200，recovery_progress_drop 0.01，recovery_stable_window_steps 0。
本轮新增：专用 recovery viewer，可以直接检查橙色 recovery 标记和预算条。

sections.title: 为什么这样做
items: Stage3.7C 的策略是滑了就等一下，但有时只是耗掉 pause budget。
Stage3.7D 增加轻微回退动作，更接近真实抓取时的接触恢复。

sections.title: 怎么验收
items: 先看固定 10 组和随机 30 组成功率。
再看 mean max slip、max hold slip 和 recovery_budget_exhausted。
最后用专用 viewer 检查视觉、触觉、滑移风险和 recovery 是否能被人直观看懂。

children.label: 已知风险
children.summary: 任务已经能完成，但 safety layer 仍要追踪提前接触、瞬时滑移、恢复预算和最终视觉遮挡。

children.label: 恢复预算仍会耗尽

这不是失败，但说明不能继续只微调一个阈值。

items: Batch0 smoke: lift_ls460 and robust_gz0025 led D-I on 12-trial smoke, so both advanced to 50-trial validation.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-B force-feedback/offset expansion
items: Use gx -0.0008 m as the next local-search center, not as a promoted baseline.

Design residual micro-adjust around geometry correction rather than direct preload force control.
Rerun 50-trial robustness and close-up visual review before any demo promotion.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-C closeout
items: Selected gx=-0.0008 m center is now the dense-capture center.
Neighbor variants did not beat the center under the shared final seed.

Next stage is dense capture, then LiftQualityHead and bounded residual micro-adjust training.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-D closeout
items: Dense sensor-fusion dataset is exported from the Stage3.11D-C selected center.

Next stage is Stage3.11D-E shadow evaluation, then bounded residual micro-adjust only if shadow checks pass.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-E closeout
items: LiftQualityHead now runs online in shadow mode without changing controller actions.
Evidence-phase shadow gate passed on 50 trials with F1 0.9992 / 0.9980 / 1.0000.

sections.title: Stage3.11D-F/G closeout
items: D-F unconditional residual micro-adjust was rejected: blind wait/close/x-retarget did not beat baseline and pre-lift retarget could damage successes.

D-H reached 137 / 150 as the max-robustness point but showed non-tip contact in visual inspection.
D-I selected gx=-0.0014 m, gz=0.0022 m, lift_steps=480 as the current demo-quality center with 136 / 150 and clean thumb-side tip-only visual evidence.
D-I thumb-side viewer/demo alias and contact-conditioned repair are backlog, not the next mainline.
